intro: E-Catalog News About Us Home Applications LEDs and Luminaire Test Solutions LEDs and Luminaire Test Solutions LISUN’s indoor and outdoor LED luminaires and LED fixtures test solutions fully cover key international standards, providing professional support for testing the safety, photometric, chromatic, and environmental adaptability performance of various LED products. Among these standards, IEC 60598-1:2020 specifies general safety requirements for luminaires, including tests for mechanical strength, electrical insulation, protection against electric shock, and fire resistance; IEC 62722-2-1:2023 focuses on the performance of LED luminaires, covering tests for luminous flux, efficacy, color temperature, color rendering index, and lumen maintenance (L70/L80/L90); CIE 121:1996 offers guidelines for photometric measurement of luminaires, emphasizing luminous intensity distribution and glare control; while IS 16101:2012 and IS 16104:2012 define energy efficiency and safety requirements for the Indian market.

intro: E-Catalog News About Us Home Applications Household Applicances Test Solutions Household Applicances Test Solutions LISUN’s household appliance testing solutions are fully compliant with IEC 60335, the fundamental international safety standard governing household and similar electrical appliances. This standard is applicable to equipment with a rated voltage not exceeding 250V for single-phase and 480V for three-phase systems. It formulates stringent safety requirements and corresponding testing methodologies spanning multiple domains, including electrical, mechanical, thermal, abnormal operation, and electromagnetic compatibility aspects. These provisions ensure that products can maintain safety under normal usage and foreseeable misuse scenarios, and must be implemented in conjunction with specific standards within the IEC 60335 series tailored to different types of electrical appliances.​

Our solutions encompass all key testing items specified in IEC 60335. These include basic safety tests such as accessibility testing, heating testing, leakage current and dielectric strength testing, and waterproof testing; electromagnetic compatibility tests covering electrostatic discharge, fast transients, surges, and other related assessments; as well as tests for mechanical strength, corrosion resistance, and flame resistance, along with specialized tests like flexing tests, salt spray tests, and drop tests. LISUN provides one-stop testing support for manufacturers and laboratories, facilitating household appliances’ compliance with global safety regulations and enabling their smooth entry into the market.

intro: E-Catalog News About Us Home Applications Cable and Wire Test Solutions Cable and Wire Test Solutions LISUN’s cable and wire test solutions are essential for verifying compliance with international safety and performance standards, providing comprehensive support for testing the performance and safety of rubber-insulated cables, PVC-insulated cables, medium and high-voltage cables, and communication cables. Among these standards, IEC 60245-1:2008 specifies requirements for rubber-insulated cables with rated voltages up to 450/750 V, covering durability, insulation, mechanical properties, and flexing tests; IEC 60227-1:2007 outlines general requirements for PVC-insulated cables within the same voltage range, including flame retardance, tensile strength, and heat shock tests. For medium and high-voltage cables, IEC 60502-1:2021 defines tests for insulation resistance, high-temperature pressure, and ozone resistance, while IEC 60840:2011 focuses on water penetration, lightning impulse voltage, and bending tests. Additionally, IEC 60189-1:2018 addresses low-frequency cables and wires, emphasizing tensile strength, insulation resistance, and mutual capacitance tests.

LISUN’s cable and wire test solutions cover all key test items specified in the above standards, equipped with a full range of professional testing equipment to meet diverse testing needs. This includes electrical performance tests (such as insulation resistance, dielectric strength, partial discharge, and capacitance measurement), mechanical performance tests (such as flexing, static flexibility, wear resistance, and tensile strength), environmental adaptability tests (such as temperature and humidity cycling, thermal shock, ozone resistance, and salt spray corrosion), and safety performance tests (such as flame retardance, resistance to heat, and pressure tests at high temperatures). By leveraging advanced automated test systems, we streamline testing processes, ensure precise data collection and analysis, and help manufacturers and laboratories verify that cable and wire products comply with IEC standards, guaranteeing their safety, reliability, and performance in various application scenarios.
